stories.title: Press Freedom Win or Judicial Overreach? Judge Blocks FCC Review of ABC Station Licenses
stories.conservative_headline: Activist Judge Shields ABC From Routine License Review, Blocks FCC's Legal Authority
stories.liberal_headline: Court Rules FCC Violated ABC's Free Speech Rights in Trump Retaliation Scheme
stories.poll_question: Was the FCC's review of ABC's licenses legitimate oversight or political retaliation?
stories.poll_option1_desc: FCC has authority to review licenses; judge overstepped into agency business.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Using licenses to punish critical coverage is unconstitutional government retaliation.

stories.title: Corruption or Common Sense? Trump's Push to Reinstate Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Rocks Washington

stories.poll_question: Should a president intervene in who runs a private company?

stories.title: Oversight or Obstruction? White House Warns Democrats That Investigating It May Be a Crime

stories.poll_option2_desc: Congress has constitutional authority to investigate; threats are intimidation.

stories.title: Mistake Corrected or Injustice Completed? Kilmar Abrego Garcia Lands in Spain After Self-Deporting

stories.title: Affordable Energy or Climate Surrender? EPA's Power Plant Carbon Rollback Faces Court Fight

stories.title: Trumpcare or Socialism? Trump Agrees to Meet El-Sayed on Universal Health Coverage

stories.title: Deterrence or Disaster? Officials Debate Targeting Iran's Leadership to End the War
